title: George H.W. Bush says public not ready for UFO truth

tellings.quote: he starts going off about how you know the American public is not ready for the truth on UFOs which is definitely offs script from what he would usually say

plain: Former US president George H. W. Bush, at a campaign event for his son Jeb Bush's run for president around 2015 or 2016, started talking about how the American public is not ready for the truth about UFOs. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and notes it was well off script for Bush; if true, it would hint that a former president knew something he felt the public could not handle.
